newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-FOREKS CHALLENGES PETERSBURG TAX ASSAULT.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-FOREKS CHALLENGES PETERSBURG TAX ASSAULT.

text.p: Foreskpank said on Wednesday that it was to take the tax police in Russia's second city St Petersburg to court over the freezing of its foreign exchange correspondence accounts.
Forekspank said in a statement that it has hired a specialist legal firm, Neva-Just, to present its case to the St Pertersburg arbitration court today.
The St Petersburg tax police have frozen the accounts of several Estonian banks, saying they had not submitted tax reports on time.
The tax police are also claiming payment of 20 percent turnover taxes on previous transactions, Forekspank said.
Forekspank stated that they see the tax police's actions as without legal basis and its legal advisors expect to overturn the tax police's actions within a week.
Hansapank , Estonia's largest bank, issued a statement saying it did not have any correspondence accounts in St Petersburg.
